title: Network
description: Detailed diagnostic template for Minecraft mod startup incompatibilities involving network.
why_it_happens: Usually caused by loader, Minecraft version, dependency, bytecode, access, or transformer mismatch.
auto_fix_strategy: Registered patch modules may create bridges, stubs, manifest updates, access-transformer corrections, or bytecode rewrites when safe.
preservation_policy: Do not remove recipes, assets, blocks, items, configs, models, localization, or gameplay mechanics.
